title: An anonymous function parameter's default is accepted and never used.
text: `callable $f = fn(int $x = 3): int => $x;` passes `nvs check`, and `$f()` throws the `LogicError` "too few arguments to a `callable`: it declares 1 parameter(s), 0 given". `check_anon_fn` binds the parameter without reading its default, and the run-time arity check counts every declared parameter. No text says whether a default is allowed here. It closes when a default on an anonymous function's parameter is either a diagnostic at the parameter or filled in when the argument is missing, with a conformance case.
